notes: Black Friday batch 3 from 5 user-supplied format references (2026-10-27): stage spotlight, ends-soon blocks, lifestyle band, risk-free pink, native alert post. Lead offer EITHER 60% OFF SITEWIDE (P48_01, 03, 04) OR buy 2 pairs + free socks and travel bag (P48_02, 05). The stage ref's 'free shipping + free gifts + up to 50%' stack becomes 60% + shipping & returns + guarantee (gifts never with the 60%). No promo codes, footnotes or SHOP NOW buttons. 'Ends soon/final hours' only for the last days of the sale.

concepts.angle: Dark Black Friday stage: shoe pair on a spotlit podium, 60% off sitewide with shipping and guarantee rows

concepts.headline: BLACK FRIDAY
concepts.prompt: Dark black stage scene with soft spotlights from above, a few black and gold balloons on the sides and small gift boxes in the shadows. Top: a huge condensed all-caps title on two lines, "BLACK" in white and "FRIDAY" in red. Center: a pair of the turquoise-and-black shoes from the product reference standing on a round glossy black podium under a spotlight, large and sharp (about 60% of the image width). Below: a solid red box with white heavy all-caps "60% OFF SITEWIDE". Under it two rows, each with a small red square holding a white plus sign followed by white all-caps text: "FREE SHIPPING & RETURNS" and "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE". No footnote, no asterisk. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.
